 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Minnesota got back in the win column Monday with a 112-100 victory over the Milwaukee Bucks. LaMelo Ball led the Timberwolves with 34 points, six rebounds and three assists, making six three-pointers. Ayo Dosunmu added 19 points, 12 rebounds and eight assists, while Jaden McDaniels scored 13 points. Minnesota led by just four points entering the fourth before going on an 11-3 run to take control. Minnesota has won five of its first eight games despite playing without Anthony Edwards, who is recovering from knee surgery.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Houston has won seven of its first eight games after beating the Boston Celtics 109-93 on Monday. Alperen Sengun scored 26 points on 12-for-15 shooting, adding 10 assists and seven rebounds. Jabari Smith Jr. finished with 14 points and 10 rebounds, while Amen Thompson also scored 14 points. Kevin Durant added 12 points as the Rockets shot 54.4% from the field. Houston never trailed and outscored Boston 50-34 in the paint, pulling away with a strong fourth quarter.
